name: Tea Time
description: Finish single player on any difficulty.

name: Love from Above
description: Destroy 4 trucks with 4 drone strikes before they reach the end of their path in 'The Embassy'.

name: Driver's Ed
description: Shoot the driver of the suicide truck.

name: Pit Stop
description: Stop three APCs with Hadir's sniper rifle.

name: Trigger Discipline
description: Do not injure any civilians in 'Piccadilly'.

name: Long Way Down
description: Crash a helicopter by shooting the pilot.

name: Nothing but Net
description: Neutralize the 'Fog of War' machine gun with a frag grenade.

name: Lights Out
description: Shut off the power to 4 buildings in 'Going Dark'.

name: Hang Time
description: Kill 3 enemies while you are on a ladder.

name: Got Something on Your Face
description: Spit on Barkov.

name: Press [BOOM] to Defuse
description: Blow up 3 tripwires with explosives.

name: Wall Hax
description: Save Alpha 3-2 from being downed.

name: Play Dead
description: Kill all the enemies in the 'Embedded' field of dead bodies.

name: Two Birds
description: Kill both soldiers with one shot in 'Hometown'.

name: Ashes to Ashes
description: Burn 4 enemies with a single molotov.

name: Out of the Fire
description: Complete every single player mission on Veteran or Realism difficulty.

name: Dodged a Bullet
description: Never get hit by the sniper while escaping captivity.

name: Hot Swap
description: Get at least one kill with eight different weapons when completing 'Old Comrades'.

name: Companion Block
description: Only use one cinder block and bring it to the end of 'Embedded'.

name: Wild Fire
description: Take down a flying helicopter with a molotov.

name: Good Effect on Target
description: Kill an enemy with a direct hit from a smoke grenade.

name: We Own the Night
description: Kill all enemies at the Church, Clocktower, and Pool without anyone calling for backup.

name: Circus Tour
description: Kill at least one enemy while inside The Reading Place, Aural Chic, and both Subway undergrounds.

name: Tunnel Rat
description: Complete 'The Wolf's Den' tunnels using only the 1911.

name: Warheads on Foreheads
description: Reach Barkov's lab entrance using only drone strikes.

name: Golden Path
description: Complete 'Clean House' without being hit using one bullet per threat.

name: Liberation
description: Complete all Special Operations missions.
